takeaway: Chronic renal failure gives metabolic acidosis: the kidneys fail to remove enough acid. MUDPILES: U is for uraemia (chronic kidney failure).

lines.text: Which arterial blood gas result does chronic renal failure give?
In chronic renal failure, the kidneys fail to remove enough acid from the body.
Metabolic acidosis may also come from the body making too much acid.
Unchecked, it leads to acidaemia, a pH less than 7.35.
lines.say: Unchecked, it leads to acidaemia, a P H less than seven point three five.
